rows.eligibility_definition: Reconstructed as held regional Z + tau_Z times native mean counterfactual dZ/dt; each is a neuron-time fraction over last10s. Recovery criterion is J<I_th, not low firing rate. Regional means use the same observer masks as the rates and drift.
rows.drift_definition: Native dZ/dt and discrete native dK/dt at the held spatial fields; G and M dynamic. Last500 preceding20ms bins, with right endpoints in (horizon-10,horizon].
rows.independent_unit: one conditional trajectory; paired initial histories, one shared future noise stream
rows.interpretation: Finite-time conditional native response; persistence alone does not certify an attractor or bifurcation.

tail_onset_intervals.interpretation: Intervals between complete brief events within this one trajectory; missing nonbrief events can lengthen them. Neither a stationarity test nor a limit-cycle certificate.

rows.temporal_quantile_definition: 10/50/90percentiles across20 nonoverlapping500ms means in the final10s; within-trajectory variability, not seed uncertainty.
rows.right_censor_definition: Incomplete activity after the last jointquiet interval>=20ms, wholeE peak>=20Hz and>=20ms observed activity; excluded from complete-event counts. Initial ongoing activity is separately left-censored.
rows.field_template_limit: Held Z/K spatial fields are defined by the job templates; matching their means does not match a natural stage-specific full state.
